# origincloud_billing_legal_document_versions (Data Source)

Lists a legal document's published versions, the latest first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `legal_document` (String) The legal document whose legal document versions to list. Its `id`, the full resource name `//billing.origincloudapis.eu/legalDocuments/{legal_document}`.

### Read-Only

- `legal_document_versions` (Attributes List) The legal document versions listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--legal_document_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--legal_document_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `legal_document_versions`

Read-Only:

- `change_class` (String) What the version changes. One of `MATERIAL`, `NOTICE`, `EDITORIAL`.
- `change_summary` (String) A plain-language summary of what changed, as the acceptance dialog and the announcement show it.
- `display_name` (String) The version's title, such as `Terms of Service`.
- `effective_date` (String) The day the version takes effect. It applies from that day until the next version of the document takes effect. A calendar date, such as `2026-11-01`.
- `html` (String) The version's text as an HTML fragment, without its title: safe to embed as it is. A reference to another legal document links the version of it in force on `effective_date`.
- `id` (String) The legal document version's full resource name, `//billing.origincloudapis.eu/legalDocuments/{legal_document}/versions/{version}`: what an argument that refers to the legal document version takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `markdown` (String) The version's source, Markdown with its YAML front matter, exactly as `sha256` is computed over it.
- `name` (String) The version's resource name, `legalDocuments/{legal_document}/versions/{version}`, where `{version}` is `YYYY-MM`, or `YYYY-MM-2`, `YYYY-MM-3` and so on for another version in the same month.
- `pdf_uri` (String) Where the version's PDF is downloaded from (DownloadLegalDocumentVersion).
- `sha256` (String) The SHA-256 of `markdown`, in lowercase hexadecimal: what identifies the version, and what an acceptance of it records.
- `uri` (String) Where the version is published on the web, under a URL that never changes, such as `https://origincloud.eu/legal/terms/2026-12`.
